en.answer:
Neither effect can be activated in response.
The effect of <<5360>> causes each player's Deck to become their Graveyard, and their Graveyard to become their Deck. This is treated neither as adding cards from the Graveyard to the Deck, nor as sending cards from the Deck to the Graveyard.
en.question: When <<5360>> is activated, can I activate the effect of either <<12950>> or <<13587>> in response?
en.title: When <<5360>> is activated, can I activate the effect of either <<12950>> or <<13587>> in response?

ja.answer:
どちらの効果もチェーンして発動できません。
「<<5360>>」の効果は、デッキが墓地に、墓地がデッキになる効果です。『●墓地からカードを手札・デッキ・EXデッキに加える効果』や『●デッキからカードを墓地へ送る効果』としては扱われません。
